name: Oonobe Youtarou
source:
Representative from Kyoto’s 5th District.
A seasoned lawmaker with a solid political base. Member of the Liberal Reform Party.
Originally in the same party as Prime Minister Sanjou, but after a split, joined the Liberal Reform Party. Currently opposed to Sanjou and working with Governor Shirasu to undermine the ruling coalition.

[Translated from [url=https://holicworks.net/24ku/mainchara.html]the official website[/url].]
